core_obligations: Reduce the statement to the vanishing-average identity labelled eq:chocolate, which is what the Fredholm alternative on the periodic cell consumes (proof lines 849-851).

For each k, test the defining equation of the auxiliary field with the corrector, average and integrate by parts to obtain the displayed identity relating the averaged products to the correctors one and two steps lower (proof lines 852-865).

Iterate that identity n+1 times starting from k = 0, using that the zeroth auxiliary field is one and that all higher ones have vanishing average, to derive the equivalent display in which the right hand side is the negative of the sum defining the integration constant; the choice of that constant therefore makes the right hand side vanish, which is the identity needed at the next step of the induction (proof lines 865-877).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the vanishing average identity (proof lines 849-851).
The averaged identity obtained by testing the auxiliary equation (proof lines 852-865).
The iteration and the role of the integration constant (proof lines 865-877).
